observations: Photo 0: Blue plastic cylindrical drum with a round lid secured by metal straps; two small round caps/ports on top.
Photo 0: Drum has visible scuffs/stains; no clear brand/model markings readable.
Photo 1: Similar blue plastic drum from a slightly different angle; lid and straps visible; same two small round caps/ports on top.
Photo 1: Background shows other similar blue drums and a jerrycan-like container; no readable labels on the main drum.

claims.evidence: No quality/testing information shown in the photos; only general statement.

risks.risk: Unknown contents/previous use (could be contaminated or unsafe for intended use).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of any label/markings on the drum side and the seller’s statement of what it was used for, plus a close-up of the inside (open lid) showing residue.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used drum with unknown/possibly contaminated contents (assume needs cleaning/unknown suitability).

risks.risk: Leak risk or lid seal condition (plastic drum may crack or the lid gasket/fit may be poor).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the lid being closed and a simple water-fill test (or pressure/leak test) showing no seepage at seams and around the caps.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed leak-free (assume may require resealing/repair).

risks.risk: Capacity/size not readable from photos (price depends heavily on volume).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of any capacity marking (e.g., 50L/100L/200L) or a tape-measure shot of height and diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case assumption for value without confirmed capacity (treat as a smaller/standard used drum rather than a large one).

risks.risk: Condition of the drum body (cracks, dents, or structural weakness not fully visible).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the entire circumference and bottom (including any dents/cracks) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with cosmetic wear and possible minor damage (no premium for condition).

proof_requests: Clear photo of any capacity/volume marking on the drum (or tape-measure height + diameter).
Close-up photos of the drum bottom and all seams for cracks/dents.
Photo/video of the inside after opening the lid (show residue/condition).
Video showing lid/caps properly closed and a leak test (or water-fill test) with no seepage.
response.reason: The photos show a used blue plastic lidded chemical storage drum, but key pricing drivers are missing: exact capacity/volume and whether it’s leak-free and safe (previous contents/inside condition). Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
